definitions.reward_spec_mismatch: Harmful failing direction = fixed-block suffixes. Pool Luna and Sol fixed-block failures; >= half have nonempty unmet assertions consisting solely of amount/format-exact assertions. Also report per-agent numerators/denominators. Mechanically exact assertion allowlist below.
definitions.hard_for_both: Harmful; both Luna fixed-native and Sol fixed-native Newcombe95% CIs have upper<0; block changes no DB field; >=1 fixed-block suffix succeeds under either agent.
definitions.capability_dependent: Harmful; Newcombe95% CI lower(Sol fixed - Luna fixed)>0.
definitions.infeasible_after_block: Harmful; block changes DB fields and zero fixed-block successes under both agents. Operational name, not proof of impossibility.
definitions.beneficial_disclosure: Beneficial; fixed block reports >=1 recognized device claim matching actual DB, whose (field,value) is absent from all16 native-reference blocks. Frozen mechanical parser; list observation coverage and missed sentences.

allowlist_scope: All saved B2 task assertions audited; this is the only amount/format-exact function in these cases. For future verified cases add a frozen amendment before classifying any new exact functions. Never infer exactness by task outcome.
ambiguity_resolution: Apply above priority, report all matching labels as well as the primary label. Pooled failure rule explicitly resolves unspecified multi-agent aggregation; per-agent diagnostics retained.
intervals: Newcombe independent-binomial score95%, as B2; exploratory unadjusted.
